worldcombat.skill.drillrun.summary: Drop low, spin up and drive a steel drill straight along the ground: every foe in the way is bitten once by the bit and up to several are pierced through; the ground is plowed into a furrow that restores itself after a while. A moving contact strike that leaves a mark, with the family's raised critical chance.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.description.0: The bit deals %1$s contact damage and lands critical hits more often.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.description.1: The run is %1$s blocks long at %2$s blocks per tick, with a drill radius of %3$s blocks; a bitten foe is shoved %4$s blocks aside so the drill can pass.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.description.2: It pierces up to %1$s foes, plows a %2$s block furrow along the way, and the furrow restores after %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.carve.on: Heavy form: a heavier drill, a longer-lasting furrow and a bigger shove, at slower and shorter runs and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.carve.off: Swift form: faster and longer runs with a shorter cooldown, at lower power and a shorter furrow.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.growth.0: From level %1$s the drill rises to %2$s and the furrow to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.growth.1: From level %1$s the drill rises to %2$s, pierces %3$s foes and plows %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.use.0: Spin straight through whoever blocks the way
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.use.1: Leaves a plowed furrow in the ground
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.use.2: Bites through several foes in one run
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.preference.ca: On: 110% power, 1.2 blocks more furrow, 40 ticks more furrow and a bigger shove, at 85% speed, 90% run length and +8 cooldown. Off: a faster, longer run and a shorter cooldown, at 94% power and 0.5 blocks less furrow.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of drilling. Larger values chase harder.
On: with two or more foes lined up in the run corridor, it drills first to pierce the line. Off: it ranks the drill as an ordinary mid-range contact strike.
worldcombat.skill.drillrun.description.3: The user races straight along the ground; each foe is bitten only once, and the run stops at a wall or an immovable body.
